prior_evaluation_conditions: Deep buffers or pure BBR deployments
untested_condition: Mixed BBR/Cubic flows on shallow-buffered edge switches
research_question: How does BBRv3 interact with high-burst Loss-Based TCP on shallow buffers?
hypothesis: BBRv3 will destructively synchronize with Cubic window reduction and systematically underestimate bottleneck bandwidth.
why_it_matters: Critical for datacenter edge deployments where shallow ToR switches are common.

untested_condition: Incremental insertion of out-of-distribution (concept drift) vectors without codebook retraining
research_question: How resilient are fixed PQ codebooks to semantic concept drift?
hypothesis: Fixed centroids will map out-of-domain vectors to overlapping sub-spaces causing silent catastrophic recall failure.
why_it_matters: RAG systems update daily; retraining indices is expensive. Silent failure is dangerous.
main_risk: Drift might not be severe enough

untested_condition: Fuzzing stateful memory allocators for deterministic fragmentation
research_question: Can coverage-guided fuzzers induce unbounded deterministic fragmentation in modern allocators?
hypothesis: Fuzzers will find allocation interleavings that cause pathological fragmentation and OOM.
why_it_matters: Exposes a new class of DoS vulnerability in allocators (jemalloc/tcmalloc).

untested_condition: Artificial injection of 5-10% packet delay jitter and MTU padding
research_question: How brittle are DL-based ETA models to simple flow obfuscation?
hypothesis: Accuracy will collapse to random guessing because models overfit to exact timing/length artifacts.
why_it_matters: Attackers can easily evade ML-NIDS using trivial padding/delay.

untested_condition: Thundering herd micro-bursts of un-cached reads alternating with idle periods
research_question: What is the tail latency penalty of compute/storage decoupling under micro-bursts?
hypothesis: Page cache invalidation and cold-fetch will cause non-linear P99 degradation compared to monolithic DBs.
why_it_matters: Serverless DBs are often used for unpredictable bursty web workloads.

untested_condition: High-velocity cold-start flooding (10k new items per hour)
research_question: Does Two-Tower retrieval exhibit systemic popularity bias against bursty new content?
hypothesis: Two-tower models will systematically rank flooded items lower until fine-tuned due to heuristic embedding initialization.
why_it_matters: News and social media rely on instant surfacing of new content.

untested_condition: Bimodal temporal shift (distributions flipping every N rounds)
research_question: Can FL models converge under periodic bimodal temporal shifts?
hypothesis: Periodic shifts will cause continuous oscillation between suboptimal states without convergence.
why_it_matters: IoT devices (e.g. cameras) experience severe day/night data shifts.

untested_condition: Training under extreme PCIe bandwidth contention (ZeRO-Infinity offloading)
research_question: How does async checkpointing interact with CPU-offloaded optimizer states over PCIe?
hypothesis: Overlapping PCIe transfers will cause massive GPU starvation and negate async benefits.
why_it_matters: Large model training relies heavily on both ZeRO offloading and frequent checkpointing.

untested_condition: Evaluation on extreme minority classes (<0.1% of dataset)
research_question: What is the disparate impact of DP-SGD clipping on extreme minority classes?
hypothesis: Gradient clipping will disproportionately erase sparse updates from extreme minorities causing recall to collapse to zero.
why_it_matters: Privacy guarantees should not come at the cost of complete failure for marginalized groups.

untested_condition: Continuous adversarial sequential insertions at the CDF boundary
research_question: How do updatable learned indexes perform under adversarial boundary insertions?
hypothesis: Repeated linear regression retraining at the boundary will cause catastrophic latency spikes.
why_it_matters: DB indexes must survive worst-case pathological workloads.

untested_condition: Strict evaluation on structural refactoring vs feature commits
research_question: Do PTS models exhibit dangerously high false-negative rates on refactoring commits?
hypothesis: Overfitting to file-path features will cause PTS to skip failing tests during structural refactorings.
why_it_matters: A false negative in PTS means a broken build is merged to main.

untested_condition: NUMA-aware multi-threaded graph processing (PageRank) spilling 20% to CXL
research_question: What is the performance penalty of CXL spilling for random-access graph workloads?
hypothesis: Lack of hardware prefetching and bus latency will cause >50% degradation compared to local NUMA spilling.
why_it_matters: CXL is marketed for database and graph analytics expansion.
